optical_onset.size_convention: z-average diameter, initial distribution, not 309 nm radius or monodisperse single droplet
optical_onset.fluence_unit: mJ/cm^2 incident at optical fiber output
optical_onset.onset_value_kind: approximate visual reading of Figure 6A after conditioned cycles, not exact tabulated datum
optical_onset.mean_value_kind: visual reading of Figure 6B, do not treat as raw-data precision
optical_onset.protocol: 10 initial pulses at 75 mJ/cm^2; 3 pulses per ramp fluence approximately 10–75 mJ/cm^2; repeated ramps interleaved with further 75 mJ/cm^2 pulses; threshold fitted from population differential-US contrast
limitations: 0 C core comparison permits PFP recondensation; not an unconditioned room-temperature threshold
Preconditioning changes size and concentration; starting DLS size is not guaranteed at threshold
Output-plane fluence, spatial attenuation, number and loading of absorbers per inclusion are not calibrated for current model

optical_onset.limitation: Largest droplets vaporize first; threshold is detectable population US contrast, not a measured threshold for one 300 nm inclusion; paper does not state pulse width.

optical_onset.absorber: silica-coated PbS nanoparticles loaded into PFP
optical_onset.applicability: Measured bulk PbS-loaded PFP solution absorption only; do not assign to pure PFP, Epolight lipid droplets, AuNR droplets or a single 300 nm PFP core.

optical_onset.environment: water/PFC/water double emulsion, glycerol immobilized optical sample
optical_onset.limitation: Average incident powers and modeling of individual-AuNR heating do not determine total absorbed energy of a current inclusion; loaded W1/O/W2 formulation, laser scanning and multiple pulses differ from 1064 nm 5 ns experiment.
